items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I worked with Jimmy Davis, he had a job for me at, uh, show bar... In round about, uh, 60, I went back with this fella, Jimmy Davis. Mm-hmm. We had a trio, uh, Andrew Johnson on drums, Jimmy Davis on piano, and, uh, me on electric guitar

ctx.x: Oh, that was around about, uh, about 47, I say, part of 48, because, uh, when that job closed down, well, I stopped playing for a while, and I, I got my job working in a plane, because I was married then, see, and I stayed out there for about four or five months, work got slowed and laid me off, and, uh, and then, uh, that was 48, yeah, part of 49. So around about, uh, August of 49, I, I made a trip down to New Orleans, to see my mother and father and the family, and, uh, that's what I got, when I came back here,…
Jimmy Davis, that's not the bass player?
